title: eng-ml
text:
eng-ml

Leah Chen: Quick check — where are lumen-13b weights supposed to live? HF origin or s3 mirror? Need presigned URL + checksum for ingest by EOD Fri.

Samir Patel: We mirrored last night to s3://redwood-models/lumen-13b/v1/ but I left the manifest untagged. checksum I calculated: sha256:9f2c3a7b8e5d... Tokenizer file seems to be tokenizer.json not tokenizer.model, so the ingest script chokes on extension.

Kai Nguyen: pinging @Samir — can you add manifest.json with `files: [weights.pt, tokenizer.json, config.json]`? Also set ACL to the model-ingest group so the CI role can read.

Samir Patel: will add manifest & update ACL to model-ingest group. Quick command (I'll adjust the grant to be org-only, not public):
```
aws s3 cp manifest.json s3://redwood-models/lumen-13b/v1/manifest.json --acl bucket-owner-full-control
# then
aws s3api put-object-acl --bucket redwood-models --key lumen-13b/v1/manifest.json --grant-full-control 'id="model-ingest-group-id"'
```
(avoiding public grants)

Maria Lopez: heads-up: tokenizer quirk — HF tokenizer for lumen-* uses trailing spaces in special tokens, our tokenizer-converter strips them by default. Add a note in manifest: `tokenizer_format: "hf-space-toks"` or run the ingest with `--hf-compat`. Otherwise long prompt spacing will shift.

Leah Chen: thanks. Also need presign for the weights, can someone generate a short-lived one for the CI job? Prefer 1h TTL.

ingest-bot: automated check: mirror_present=true, manifest_present=false, checksum_match=false

Samir Patel: updated manifest, added tokenizer_format, uploaded checksum (sha256:9f2c3a7b8e5d4f6... ). generating presign now:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-models/lumen-13b/v1/weights.pt --expires-in 3600
```
Presign URL: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-models/lumen-13b/v1/weights.pt?X-Amz-Algorithm=... (redacted)

Kai Nguyen: created PR #578 to add the model gating rules + canary rollout config (rollout: 10% -> 100%) and a small ingest playbook. PTAL @Leah

Leah Chen: looking. Small ask — ensure server-side encryption with KMS key alias/rw-models is enabled for the object. Security will flag plaintext buckets.

Samir Patel: added SSE-KMS header when uploading: `--sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/rw-models` in the upload step.

Maria Lopez: tested ingest with `pipelines/ingest --source s3 --hf-compat` — passed local smoke tests. Noticed tokenization diffs on long prompts, but within expected tolerances. Added a tiny eval set in the PR to catch regressions.

Leah Chen: awesome. Follow-ups: (1) add presign URL to PR description (expires in 1h), (2) add the tokenizer eval slice to the repo, (3) schedule a quick post-merge smoke run on dedicated infra.

Kai Nguyen: done — review requested on #578.

Leah Chen: thanks all :thumbsup:
